document.abstract: Some of the problems involved in developing a program of military and civilian training films are briefly described, in addition to the manner of using the films in peace-time and war-time training. The relation between the Signal Corps and the storage of historical film in the New Archives Building at Washington, D. C., is briefly referred to.
